column1: # Retrieved 2026-10-20. 29 rows: 17 ECMA-262 editions (channel edition) and 12
#   Netscape/Mozilla JavaScript versions (channel final). ECMAScript has no single tag series
#   the release unit is the published edition or version (LANG84 "Every tagged release").
# es2016-es2026: tc39/ecma262 tags; source_sha is the commit the tag names.
# es1-es2015: Ecma archive PDFs; source_sha `-` until release_evidence.py records their SHA-256
#   (ecma-international.org was unreachable from the inventory environment).
# js1.x: MDN archived 'New in JavaScript' pages pinned in mdn/archived-content (or mdn/content for
#   1.8.2); source_sha is the page's git blob ID.
# date: reduced precision (YYYY-MM or YYYY) when the source states only a month or year;
#   `?` marks a date taken from a secondary source. See README.md for every date's source.
# excluded: ES4 (ECMA-262 4th edition) -- abandoned in 2008 and never published.
#   Ecma General Assembly approval; the approved edition is the esYYYY tag.
# excluded: tc39/ecma262 tag es2026-errata -- errata to the published ES2026 edition.
# existing_pair: pre-LANG84 pairs in this directory. They do not cite source_ref/source_sha and
